material.acceptance_criteria: delta.js line 1 reads FULL_EVERY frames; node --check js/client/delta.js passes; delta CI test green
material.description: js/client/delta.js:1 says 'a full state frame every FULL_EVERY ticks'. createStateEncoder (delta.js:16-17) counts encode() calls, so the period is FULL_EVERY frames. Comment-only fix: reword line 1 to 'every FULL_EVERY frames'. Also: the applyFrame comment (delta.js:33-34) says the receiver ignores deltas before a state frame; that gate lives in play.js:545-546 (netBaseline), not in applyFrame, so the comment describes the caller. Move it to play.js or state the precondition on applyFrame.
material.resolution: verifier gm-orch-1-20-v1: comment-only change to 'every FULL_EVERY frames'; encoder counts frames. CI run 39065835817 success on tip e03ee19 (24/24 jobs), which contains this sha
